scope_recommendation: Northeast Indiana — The REFINERY 12-county region. A fresh screening of all 69 teams listed on the official 2026 FIRST Indiana district roster found 13 official hometowns within these counties; these match the existing Indiana research cohort. Geography uses official FIRST profile hometown, not workshop location or student residence.
geography_correction: Matthews belongs to Grant County and is explicitly included in The REFINERY service-area list; do not remove Team 1720 on an incorrect Delaware County assumption.

ranking_basis.producer_note: Local ordering derived from Statbotics. This is an independent model-based list, not an official FIRST ranking or a voted poll; the June snapshot is not live October performance. EPA is not a win-loss record or a ranking of educational value. Do not compare FRC EPA numerically with FTC ratings.

hero.headline: The only sport where everyone can go pro.
hero.suggested_subhead: Friday-night energy. Skills for a lifetime. Meet the Northeast Indiana students building their future in engineering, software, manufacturing and business.
hero.attribution_note: FIRST uses the variant “the only sport where every kid can go pro.” FIRST Global uses the requested everyone variant with a registered mark. Attribute the campaign message in small source text. Explain go pro through career-relevant skills; do not imply employment, admission, earnings, or paid competition are guaranteed.

editorial_guidance: Keep separate FTC and FRC boards; use a shared regional robotics brand if both are shown.
Use a 16:9 board with one selected-team spotlight and producer notes for sourced role/date context.
Use Student leader / Coach or mentor fields with exact documented role; an unverified field should read Not verified, not No coach.
Do not use live, latest, current captains, head coach, playoff race, moving up/down or poll votes without corresponding evidence.
No movement arrows are supportable from a single frozen snapshot.
The two leading EPA values differ by only 0.19 points; the model uncertainties are much larger, so avoid a dominance narrative.
No students or coaches have been contacted; use published names and school/team sources only.
